result.instructions: Tools for Scrada, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the journals of our company and show their settings."; "Show all journal lines booked in March 2026, with their amounts."; "Which inbound Peppol invoices are still waiting for confirmation?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Scrada data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run scrada_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run scrada_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run scrada_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. scrada_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: scrada_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get the Scrada company that the API key belongs to: name, active flag and settings.

tools.name: scrada_list_journals
tools.title: List journals
tools.description: List all journals (daily receipts books) of the company, with their settings.

tools.name: scrada_get_journal
tools.title: Get journal
tools.description: Get one journal by its ID.

tools.name: scrada_list_journal_lines
tools.title: List journal lines
tools.description: List the booked lines of a journal, from every source, sorted by marker. Returns __next and __marker: keep calling with afterMarker until __next is null. Use fromDate and tillDate (yyyy-mm-dd) to limit the period.

afterMarker.description: Marker from the previous page (__marker). Omit to start from the beginning.

fromDate.description: Only lines dated on or after this day.

tillDate.description: Only lines dated on or before this day.

tools.name: scrada_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: List the payment methods that belong to one journal.

tools.name: scrada_list_vat_categories
tools.title: List VAT categories
tools.description: List the VAT categories that belong to one journal.

tools.name: scrada_list_vat_periods
tools.title: List VAT periods
tools.description: List all VAT periods of the company.

tools.name: scrada_list_cash_books
tools.title: List cash books
tools.description: List all cash books (bank accounts and cash registers) of the company.

tools.name: scrada_get_cash_book
tools.title: Get cash book
tools.description: Get one cash book by its ID.

tools.name: scrada_list_transaction_types
tools.title: List transaction types
tools.description: List the transaction types (booking categories) of one cash book.

tools.name: scrada_list_sales_invoice_journals
tools.title: List sales invoice journals
tools.description: List all sales invoice journals of the company, including inactive ones.

tools.name: scrada_get_sales_invoice_journal
tools.title: Get sales invoice journal
tools.description: Get one sales invoice journal by its ID.

tools.name: scrada_get_sales_invoice_send_status
tools.title: Get sales invoice send status
tools.description: Get the send status of a sales invoice that was created through the API.

tools.name: scrada_add_sales_invoice_payment
tools.title: Add sales invoice payment
tools.description: Record a payment on an existing final sales invoice. It updates the invoice payment status but is not booked to a journal or cash book. Not safe to repeat: each call adds another payment. A positive amount settles the invoice; a negative amount reverses a settlement.

paymentType.description: 1 Unknown, 2 Wire transfer, 3 Bank card (iDeal), 4 Direct debit, 5 Cash, 6 Credit card, 7 Online payment provider, 8 Cheque, 9 Debit card (Bancontact), 10 Standing agreement.

name.description: Name of the payment method, for example Bank transfer.

externalPaymentMethodID.description: ID of the payment method in your own system, if you have one.

amount.description: Amount paid. Positive settles the invoice, negative reverses a settlement. Cannot be 0.

paymentDate.description: Day of the payment, yyyy-mm-dd. Default today; cannot be in the future.

tools.name: scrada_list_pos_receipts
tools.title: List POS receipts
tools.description: List POS receipts of the company, sorted by marker. Returns __next and __marker: keep calling with afterMarker until __next is null. A receipt can reappear when it changes, so match on receiptID.

afterMarker.description: Marker from the previous page (__marker). Omit to start from the beginning.

fromReceiptCreatedOn.description: Only receipts created on or after this moment. Include a timezone, for example 2026-03-09T08:00:00Z.

tillReceiptCreatedOn.description: Only receipts created on or before this moment. Include a timezone.

tools.name: scrada_peppol_lookup
tools.title: Look up a Peppol participant
tools.description: Search the Peppol network for a participant. The id has two parts joined by a colon: the scheme code and the value, for example 0208:0793904121 (0208 is the Belgian enterprise number scheme).

scheme.description: Participant identifier scheme, for example iso6523-actorid-upis.

id.description: Participant identifier as scheme code, colon, value.

tools.name: scrada_list_unconfirmed_peppol_documents
tools.title: List unconfirmed Peppol documents
tools.description: List inbound Peppol documents that are not confirmed yet (metadata only, up to 100 per call). Confirmed documents leave the list, so confirm each processed document to see the next ones.

tools.name: scrada_get_peppol_inbound_document
tools.title: Get Peppol inbound document
tools.description: Get one inbound Peppol document as UBL/XML (returned as text).

tools.name: scrada_confirm_peppol_inbound_document
tools.title: Confirm Peppol inbound document
tools.description: Mark an inbound Peppol document as processed, so it leaves the unconfirmed list. Confirming it again is expected to change nothing.

tools.name: scrada_get_peppol_outbound_status
tools.title: Get Peppol outbound document status
tools.description: Get the status and delivery information of an outbound Peppol document.

prompts.title: Get started with Scrada
